player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id}. Nga ni kubapa Game ya Kumbukumbu.
Cilole nga ni kubapa mipando ya kareti zaidi kwenye bodo, kuliko mpinzani wako.
Pa zamu yako, sangula mipando miwili ya kubadilisha kwa kuingiza nambari za safu na safu wima za kareti ya kwanza na ya pili mtawalia kama '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo kareti ya kwanza iko safu 0 na safu wima 1, na kareti ya pili iko safu 1 na safu wima 0.
Ukibadilisha mipando miwili yakafanana, unapata alama na mipando inasalia juu. Ukibadilisha mipando isiyolingana, mipando inabadilishwa chini tena, mfano '.'.
Game inaisha ukibadilisha mipando yote.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Player {player_id} did not respond with a valid direction in square brackets. Umulashi wa cisankano tailelandapo bwino pa fyo alefwaya ukucinda mu cipatala, lelo alilembele fye amashiwi ya kucincisha ayali muli ici cikope ninshi na o te kuti acite ifyo alefwaya ukucita.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ukuya kwabula ukusuminishiwa. Umulashi {player_id} asalile ukuli pa nse ya ciputulwa ca icibwato.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ukuposa kwa bufi. {player_id} aasala umukashi umo imiku ibili.
invalid_move.already_matched: Ukuposa kwabula ukufikapo. Umulashi {player_id} asalilepo nangu ama kardi yonse yabili ayali na mabala ayalingana kale.

game_message.cards_match: Mipando iliyosanguliwa na Player {player_id} kwenye nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] inafanana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Mipando iliyosanguliwa na Player {player_id} haifanani. Mipando kwenye nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} na {pos2} mtawalia.

outcome.draw: Bonse babili bapangile ifikope fimo fine.
outcome.turn_limit: Mipaka ya mzunguko imeridhika. Mchezo umemaliza. Mwana 0 amepata alama {score_0}, Mwana 1 amepata alama {score_1}.
